skill.summary: Advanced expert in prompt engineering, custom instructions design, and prompt optimization for AI agents

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Prompt Engineering Expert skill.
- Provides advanced guidance on writing, optimizing, and evaluating AI prompts.
- Supports custom instruction and system prompt design for AI agents.
- Includes expertise in advanced techniques such as chain-of-thought prompting, few-shot examples, and context management.
- Offers use cases for prompt refinement, debugging, template creation, and best practices education.
